anchor.note: Insert the pack/loader before the SugarCube script-libraries block emitted by Tweego.

integrate.note: Official stock 0.5.13.8 runs the SugarCube boot body through jQuery((()=>...)). It must be moved behind window.mainStart so mods initialize first.

notes: Verified on the official stock 0.5.13.8 HTML (sha256 7191c738...), not just a roundtrip from the Neo build.
Bare loader, 2-mod pack (ModLoaderGui + ModLoaderNeoUI), and all 26 built-in mods were installed from this stock file and boot-smoked to the Start passage; 26 mods were loaded with no dialogs.
The SugarCube engine is 381366 bytes and shares its first 380004 bytes with the 0.5.12.13 Neo engine; only the boot wrapper differs.
The installer refactors that wrapper into window.mainStart, injects dist/i10n-sc2patch.js, then installs the loader and optional pack.
Import guards are optional on stock; a missing anchor is reported as a warning, not a failure.
